'''Dragon's Eye''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Any phase''': Exhaust and lose 1 [[Sanity]] after drawing a [[gate]] or [[location]] card to draw a new card in its place.

'''Price''': $6
